translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Pako Jehova Nyasaye en gima ber kendo wero wende mapako nyingi
bende ber, yaye Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo,
hulo herani gokinyi
kod adierani gotieno,
kiwer gi nyatiti matin
ma tondene apar ka wer ridore gi nyatiti maduongʼ ber adier.
Nimar timbeni miya mor, yaye Jehova Nyasaye;
awer gi mor nikech tije ma lweti otimo.
Mano kaka tijeni dongo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye,
mano kaka pachi tut miwuoro!
Ngʼama omingʼ ok nyal ngʼeyo,
joma ofuwo ok winj tiend wachno,
ni kata obedo ni joma timbegi richo nyalo loth kaka lum
kendo joricho nyalo dhi maber,
to ibiro tiekgi chuth nyaka chiengʼ.
To in, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ibiro siko kimiyi duongʼ nyaka chiengʼ.
Nimar ka kuom adier, yaye Jehova Nyasaye,
ka kuom adier to wasiki duto biro lal nono;
joricho duto ibiro ke mel.
Isemiyo tungena odoko ma roboche ka tunge jowi;
oseol kuoma modhi maliw.
Aseneno gi wengena ka iloyo wasika
kendo asewinjo gi itena ka joma oramona ma timbegi richo itieko.
Joma kare biro loth maber ka yiend othith,
gibiro dongo ka yiend sida mar Lebanon;
Nikech opidhgi e od Jehova Nyasaye,
gibiro loth e agolni mag Nyasachwa.
Kata hikgi oniangʼ to pod gininyag mana olemo,
kendo ginisik ka ginyien kendo gingʼich,
ka gilando niya “Jehova Nyasaye oriere tir;
en e Lwandana, kendo onge richo moro amora kuome.”
